column2:
ggplot(datos_bio, aes(x = Lat, y = .data[[v]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = label,
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = 1.3,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Latitude",
      y = sub("wc2\\.1_5m_", "", v)
    )
